findings.evidence: “This skill is a Process ... executed with Tool-level rigor” describes the skill using rubric pattern labels rather than guiding the setup.
findings.fix: Remove the pattern labels and record the removal; retain the operational reason to use the factory subcommands instead of hand-typing fields.

findings.evidence: The description mentions “--check-only” and migration mechanics but does not clearly trigger on a plain availability check or a migrate-only request, and gives no boundary against running an already configured review or editing unrelated config.
findings.fix: Set up or refresh ai-kit cross-AI review and execute lanes: detect CLIs and models, propose role-specific sets, ask the owner for choices and write the lanes table in config.toml. Use when asked to configure reviewers or executors, check their availability without changing configuration, or migrate an old review-spec.toml roster, even without naming the wizard. Supports --check-only, --local and --global; asks before replacing a roster and announces the target path. Not for running an already configured review or editing unrelated config tables.

findings.evidence: The main file has 423 lines and 5,961 words, exceeding the recommended approximately 5,000-token body despite its conditional references.
findings.fix: Keep the core routing, safety gates and write/report sequence in SKILL.md; move runtime-specific details from Step 2.4 into a focused reference loaded when those runtimes are selected, preserving their behavior.

findings.evidence: The live-test warning says the CLI runs “against the working tree,” but ai_kit_spec/quota.py's _run_probe uses a private temporary cwd for check-reviewer and probe-quota. references/check-only.md repeats the same working-tree claim.
findings.fix: Describe the actual private probe cwd in both warnings, while still explaining that unconfirmed or custom CLIs can have normal permissions and may access files outside that cwd. Obtain consent before running them.

findings.evidence: The instruction says “Do NOT load references/cli-model-selection.md unless wizard-flow.md step 2 sends you there,” but wizard-flow.md step 6 requires its item 6 for every kept lane, including runs where step 2 did not trigger.
findings.fix: Make the loading conditions consistent: either allow loading cli-model-selection.md for the step 6 alternative check, or put that check's complete guidance in wizard-flow.md and reserve the reference for step 2.

findings.evidence: The version-sensitive claim “Today only Claude Code selects a model per call (its sonnet, opus, haiku and fable aliases)” has no dated official source or instruction to verify the host capability live.
findings.fix: Tie the statement to the runner's current native-selector support and provide the official Claude Code model-selection documentation URL and date checked, or instruct the agent to verify the applicable host capability live.
